title: When the Cipher Turns
author: Ivo Coldharbour
blurb: Gideon Dravenmoor, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
